name: SideNav
purpose: A collapsible application navigation rail with groups, counts, search, workspace content, and a footer.
description: Organize a workspace into stable destinations and nested groups.

props.name: brandIcon
props.description: Pass null to show only the brand name.

props.name: showWorkspace
props.description: Show the expanded workspace summary below the brand.

props.name: workspaceContent
props.description: Replace the expanded workspace summary; hidden and inert in the collapsed rail.

guidance.overview: A collapsible application navigation rail with groups, counts, search, workspace content, and a footer.
usage: Supply activeId and onNavigate; the component does not manage application routes.
Expanded groups reveal nested destinations. Collapsed groups use menus, while leaf items retain accessible names and tooltips.
The search shortcut shown in the rail is only a hint; wire onSearch and register the actual shortcut in the host.
accessibility: The active destination exposes aria-current="page"; group controls expose expanded state and the content relationship.
Custom workspaceContent is hidden and inert while collapsed, so its hidden controls cannot receive focus.
context: Use as persistent application navigation, with responsive collapse controlled by the application shell when necessary.
